judged.what: 100 Thieves closes out a round to get their first point on the board, leading the creator to yell 'Get him out of my face bro!' and stand up to celebrate.
judged.reason: A solid round-winning moment that gets 100T on the board, paired with a energetic standing reaction from the creator. The kills themselves are fairly standard, but the high hype and milestone round win make it a keepable clip.
